definition.name: Guest tool bundle and maintained application builds (${{ matrix.language }})

steps.name: Select the runner-owned compiler archive cache
steps.run: printf 'LSF_DEV_COMPILER_CACHE=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/compiler-archives" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Restore untrusted pinned compiler archives
Stage the pinned relocatable Python prefix
steps.run:
image='python@sha256:4c2cf9917bd1cbacc5e9b07320025bdb7cdf2df7b0ceaccb55e9dd7e30987419'
container=$(docker create "$image")
trap 'docker rm "$container"' EXIT
prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools-cpython"
mkdir "$prefix"
docker cp "$container:/usr/local/." "$prefix"
printf 'LSF_DEV_PYTHON_PREFIX=%s\n' "$prefix" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Restore untrusted source-pinned Java prepared inputs
Acquire the source-pinned Java compiler build inputs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
input=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-input.XXXXXXXX)
rmdir "$input"
python -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py acquire --output "$input"
printf 'LSF_DEV_JAVA_COMPILER_INPUT=%s\n' "$input" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Save only reverified Java prepared input bytes
Assemble pinned compiler tools and maintained templates
steps.run: python tools/build_dev_guest_tools.py --language "$LSF_DEV_LANGUAGE" --output target/dev-tools --python-prefix "$LSF_DEV_PYTHON_PREFIX" --node-tests

steps.name: Save independently verified compiler archive bytes
Compile actual projects with isolated tools and separate operator packaging
steps.run: python tools/run_dev_guest_tools_tests.py --language "$LSF_DEV_LANGUAGE" --payload target/dev-tools/payload --packager target/dev-tools/latent-test --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-projects"

steps.name: Prepare selected TypeScript captured-compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Exercise delivered TypeScript dependency review and signed watch
steps.run:
python -m unittest tools.tests.test_typescript_dependency_watch
sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v python)" -B tools/run_typescript_dependency_watch_ci.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-dependency-watch" --qualifier tools/qualify_typescript_dependency_watch.py --fixture tools/typescript_dependency_watch_fixture.py --node-probe tools/dev_node_application_probe.py

Qualify the static site and TypeScript API in Chromium
steps.run:
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix tools/static_api
node tools/static_api/node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install --with-deps chromium
python tools/static_api/ci.py --bin target/dev-tools/source-node/bin --signer target/dev-tools/payload/sdk/bin/capsule-test-signer --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-projects/static-api/build" --browser-tools tools/static_api --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-projects/static-api"

steps.name: Compare explicit clock fixtures on signed nodes and the Linux portable host
steps.run:
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml build --locked -p latent-portable-test-host
python -c "import shutil; shutil.copy2('target/debug/latent-portable-test-host','target/dev-tools/clock-host')"
python tools/dev_clock_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --portable-host target/dev-tools/clock-host --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-clock-fixtures"
python tools/dev_failure_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --portable-host target/dev-tools/clock-host --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-failure-fixtures"
python tools/dev_http_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --portable-host target/dev-tools/clock-host --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-http-fixtures"
python tools/dev_blob_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-blob-fixtures"
python tools/dev_secret_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-secret-fixtures"
python tools/dev_metric_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --portable-host target/dev-tools/clock-host --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-metric-fixtures"
python tools/dev_local_service_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-local-service-fixtures"
python tools/dev_event_fixture_probe.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-event-fixtures"
sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v python)" -B tools/run_dev_recovery_ci.py --probe isolation --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-workspace-isolation"
sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v python)" -B tools/run_dev_recovery_ci.py --probe watch --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-watch-fixtures"
sudo --preserve-env=GITHUB_ACTIONS,RUNNER_OS "$(command -v python)" -B tools/run_dev_recovery_ci.py --payload target/dev-tools/payload --source-node target/dev-tools/source-node --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-recovery-fixtures"
